instruction: A candid action photograph, full shot at eye-level, captures a judo practice session inside a dojo with a blue wall and yellow tatami mat. The woman in the blue judo gi (R1) is seen from behind in a defensive stance, knees slightly bent. Facing her, the young man in the white judo gi (R2) stands on the right, gripping her shoulder with his right hand as they engage in a sparring match. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the floor, highlighting the blue and yellow contrast of the training area.
